# Event-Driven Architecture Standards

This directory contains standards for implementing event-driven patterns using .NET, Kafka, and RabbitMQ.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/event-driven/README.md#std-app-evt-001-net-kafka-consumer]

### STD-APP-EVT-001: .NET Kafka Consumer

Standards for implementing Kafka consumers in .NET applications including consumer configuration, message handling, error handling, offset management, and graceful shutdown.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/event-driven/README.md#std-app-evt-002-net-kafka-producer]

### STD-APP-EVT-002: .NET Kafka Producer

Standards for implementing Kafka producers in .NET applications including producer configuration, message serialization, partitioning strategies, idempotency, and error handling.
page_texts.6:
[standards/application/event-driven/README.md#std-app-evt-003-net-event-sourcing]

### STD-APP-EVT-003: .NET Event Sourcing

Standards for implementing event sourcing pattern in .NET including event store design, aggregate root patterns, event versioning, and projection management.
page_texts.7:
[standards/application/event-driven/README.md#std-app-evt-004-net-cqrs]

### STD-APP-EVT-004: .NET CQRS

Standards for implementing Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) pattern in .NET including command/query separation, read/write models, and eventual consistency handling.
page_texts.8:
[standards/application/event-driven/README.md#std-app-evt-005-net-event-batching]

### STD-APP-EVT-005: .NET Event Batching

Standards for implementing efficient event batching in .NET applications including batch size optimization, batch processing patterns, and failure recovery.
page_texts.9:
[standards/application/event-driven/README.md#std-app-evt-006-net-eaas-sdk]

### STD-APP-EVT-006: .NET EaaS SDK

Standards for using the Enterprise Event as a Service (EaaS) SDK in .NET applications including SDK configuration, event publishing, event consumption, and SDK best practices.
page_texts.10:
[standards/application/event-driven/README.md#std-app-evt-007-rabbitmq-enterprise-messaging-standard]

### STD-APP-EVT-007: RabbitMQ Enterprise Messaging Standard

Enterprise-wide mandatory standard for RabbitMQ (Amazon MQ) deployments covering vhost isolation policy, naming conventions, exchange and queue configuration, TLS/credential management, dead-letter queue policy, message durability, connection management, and observability requirements.
page_texts.11:
[standards/application/event-driven/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Consistent event-driven architecture patterns
- Reliable event processing and delivery
- Efficient use of Kafka and RabbitMQ infrastructure
- Proper error handling and recovery
- Scalable event-driven applications
